title: Because mine was the 8th
html_source: Molly’s birthday is September 8, 1870. Ulysses takes place on June 16, 1904, putting Molly a couple of months off her 34th birthday.

anchor.prefix: n seeing it too young then writing a letter every morning sometimes twice a day I liked the way he made love then he knew the way to take a woman when he sent me the 8 big poppies
anchor.suffix: then I wrote the night he kissed my heart at Dolphins barn I couldnt describe it simply it makes you feel like nothing on earth but he never knew how to embrace well like Gardner
